Portrait: Broad frame — wide shoulders and chest filling the horizontal space, thick limbs, substantial torso. The body reads heavy and wide in the crop. Female: shoulders wide over a defined waist, sturdy neck, full rounded jaw, the chest line above a waist that still narrows. Male: shoulders and neck heavy, jaw wide and square, a flat broad chest straight to the waist. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at this width.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
